reasoning: A universally recognizable lidded trash can icon. It fits two very common groups of tasks equally well: literal household chores involving garbage, bins, and waste collection, and digital tasks about deleting files or emptying the trash folder. It is completely distinct unless variants with a plus, slash, or recycling symbol are present.
